exposure: unidirectional valve patch repair of ventricular septal defect
outcome: New York Heart Association functional class
cohort: Thirty-five acyanotic patients aged 2 to 26 years (mean 9.3 years) with a large ventricular septal defect and elevated pulmonary vascular resistance underwent surgery.
finding: Although relatively high mortality occurred during long-term follow-up, surviving patients were in a better condition and functional class despite persistent pulmonary artery hypertension, suggesting surgery should not be prohibited due to fear of persistent pulmonary artery hypertension.
mod_finding: One patient experienced a full-term delivery by caesarean section five years post-operation.
